_meta.purpose: Maps PWC coaching nudge IDs to the Engine 2 skill_ids they teach. Used by services/pwc_skill_gate.py to gate live coaching by user's mastery state — suppress nudges for mastered skills, escalate nudges for struggling skills.
rules_for_adding: Each nudge_id key MUST correspond to a real coaching candidate string used in realtime_coaching_feedback.py or the legacy coaching engine.
Each value MUST be a list of skill_ids from data/coaching/skill_tree.json. Most nudges map to ONE skill; some teach multiple.
When a new concept_detector ships, add the matching coaching nudge here so the gate can fire on it.
Nudges not in this map = ungated (default behaviour — no change from today).
